overview: This paper proposes LDAR, a learning-based adaptive retriever that utilizes a policy gradient method to learn a distraction-aware band-based retrieval strategy from similarity distributions, balancing information coverage and distraction for efficient knowledge grounding in long-context LLMs.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Chunking
modules.description: Handles the loading of long-context documents, text cleaning, and the sliding-window chunking strategy to partition documents into fixed-size passages with overlapping tokens for subsequent retrieval processing.

modules.name: Similarity Distribution Construction
modules.description: Implements the feature engineering pipeline that uses a pre-trained embedding model to encode queries and passages, computing the cosine similarity vector that serves as the sole input feature for the adaptive retriever.

modules.name: Adaptive Retriever Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the neural network model for the retriever policy, encompassing periodic embeddings for numerical features, a self-attention Transformer encoder, and an attention pooling mechanism that outputs parameters for Beta distributions to define retrieval quantiles.

modules.name: Band-based Retrieval Sampler
modules.description: Implements the sampling logic that draws lower and upper quantiles from the predicted Beta distributions, selects the contiguous band of passages from the sorted similarity list, and handles the mapping from quantiles to actual passage indices.

modules.name: LLM Inference Interface
modules.description: Provides a unified wrapper for interacting with various large language models (open-source and closed-source), formatting the retrieved passage sets as context, querying the model, and extracting the generated answer.

modules.name: Answer Verification and Reward Generation
modules.description: Implements the evaluation logic that compares the LLM's prediction against the ground truth using a judge model, producing the binary reward signal required for the reinforcement learning objective.

modules.name: Policy Gradient Optimizer
modules.description: Contains the core reinforcement learning algorithm (REINFORCE), calculating the likelihood ratio gradient using the log-probabilities of the sampled quantile actions and the binary reward signal to update the retriever's weights.

modules.name: Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the overall training workflow, including epoch iteration, batch sampling of similarity distributions, executing the retrieval-inference-reward cycle, gradient accumulation, and periodic model checkpointing.

modules.name: Baseline Retrieval Implementations
modules.description: Implements the comparison methods used in the study, such as standard top-k retrieval, long-context (LC) full passage injection, RAG with reranking, Adaptive-k gap detection, and heuristic routing strategies.

modules.name: Evaluation and Statistical Analysis
modules.description: Calculates all core metrics including task accuracy, token usage ratio relative to long-context, and standard errors; supports aggregation of results across different context lengths and model architectures.

modules.name: Cost Analysis and Visualization
modules.description: Performs computational efficiency analysis by measuring inference time and GPU hours, and generates visual outputs such as training curves, sliding-window performance plots, and retrieval band distribution charts to analyze the learned strategies.
